description: 09/03/2026 SIDBI was honoured to welcome Sudha Chandran ji as the team came together to celebrate the spirit of womanhood in the presence of the DMD, SIDBI. The occasion was marked by an atmosphere of admiration and inspiration, as her presence added depth and meaning to the celebration. Through her powerful life journey and moving words, she reminded everyone that determination, resilience, and courage can overcome even the most formidable challenges.
